GNU fileutils 3.15 for AmigaOS (ixemul), from the Amiga Development
Environment (Geek Gadgets) as published on Aminet:

  binaries  https://aminet.net/dev/gg/fileutils-bin.lha  (ls, dircolors here)
  source    https://aminet.net/dev/gg/fileutils-src.lha  (in this drawer:
            fileutils-3.15-src.lha, the complete corresponding source)
